name: OmaLLDownloader
author: DimDoremy
description: Download activity in the Omarchy bar: how many tasks are running, the total speed, and a popup with each task's progress. Reads `omad tasks --json`, so it shows the same list the app and the CLI see.

barWidget.description: Download count and speed, with a popup of every task.

schema.label: omad command
schema.description: Path to the omad executable, if it is not on the shell's PATH.

schema.label: Show when idle
schema.description: Keep the glyph visible with no tasks instead of hiding it.
